artworks.title: Portrait of Christiane Henriette Koch as Pelopia
artworks.description: Johann Friedrich Bause's Metropolitan Museum print shows the actress Christiane Henriette Koch costumed as Pelopia — Thyestes' daughter and mother of Aegisthus in the Atreid horror. Eighteenth-century stage culture kept the Sicyonian tragedy of the sword and the unrecognized incest alive as a role for leading ladies.
